record.kind: OnAbilityCastEffect (shared instance): attack catch-up to the strongest same-team holder
record.summary: PassiveEffects[Passive.BASCULIN_RED_BLUE] holds one OnAbilityCastEffect. After a Basculin Red / Blue casts its ability (castAbility, after the strategy's process, and only if the cast was not refused), the effect collects all living entities on the caster's team that hold the passive (board.cells, caster included), takes the one with the highest current attack, and, if the caster's attack is lower, requests the difference as an attack gain on the caster (addAttack(delta, caster, 0, false)). If the caster already has the highest attack (or ties it) nothing happens. The effect reads the attackers' current attack values at that moment, including temporary changes, and only ever raises the caster's attack; it never lowers the leader's. It is not permanent.
triggers: OnAbilityCastEffect: after each successful ability cast by a unit with this passive (castAbility in cast.ts)

effects.declaredRaw: requested +(highest same-passive team attack - caster attack) attack on the caster, only when positive
effects.scaling: apBoost 0 and crit false with the caster being the unit itself: no AP or crit factor (the value is rounded by Math.round, which does not change an integer). applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff then applies to a positive value: a Big Eater Belt holder gains 1.25 x delta rounded down, so it can overshoot the leader's attack; applyTwistBandBuff does not apply to a positive value. addAttack keeps attack at least 1. core-mechanics §I and item-effects.md (BIG_EATER_BELT, TWIST_BAND) were consulted.
effects.resolution: requested delta = leader.atk - caster.atk (leader chosen among living same-team holders, the caster included); applied = delta, or floor(1.25 x delta) with a Big Eater Belt; permanent is false, so only the fight entity changes. Because the leader may be a different unit, the caster can end above, at or (with rounding) near the leader's attack depending on the item.

effects.declaredRaw: holders = board entities of the caster's team whose passive is BASCULIN_RED_BLUE
effects.resolution: only units with this passive qualify (Basculin Red and Blue; Basculin White has a different passive); dead holders are gone from the board cells, so a dead leader no longer counts.
